meta.name: iron-proxy-gateway
meta.description: Use Iron Proxy for external accounts and APIs, including GitHub through gh. Connect credentials through the operator console and diagnose blocked requests without exposing tokens or adding unnecessary MCP servers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让外部账号和接口调用都走代理,排查被拦截的请求,不用暴露密钥
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 想让程序安全访问 GitHub 等外部账号,又不想把令牌暴露出去
copy.tagline_en: Route API calls through a proxy, trace blocked requests, keep tokens hidden
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your programs need external accounts like GitHub without exposing tokens

howto.what: 所有对外 HTTP/HTTPS 请求都经会话的 Iron Proxy 转发。连账号时它执行 ncl groups connect,把 connect_url 交给你,凭据由操作员在控制台配置;遇 403/401 只报告主机名和错误,不索取也不打印 token。
howto.when: 当你需要访问外部账号或 API(如用 gh 访问 GitHub),或请求被 403/401 拦下、需要确认是哪一层拦截时触发。

say.text: 帮我连一下 api.github.com 这个账号
say.note: 它会返回 connect_url,由操作员配置凭据

say.text: 用 gh 查一下我的 GitHub 仓库
我请求 GitHub 被 403 了,帮我查是哪一层拦的
say.note: 它会报告主机名和错误,请操作员侧检查

howto.what_en: Outbound HTTP/HTTPS traffic goes through your session's Iron Proxy. Connecting an account runs ncl groups connect and returns a connect_url for an operator to set credentials; on 403/401 it just reports the hostname and error, never tokens.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need an external account or API (including GitHub via gh), or when a request comes back 403/401 and you need to find out which layer blocked it.

say_en.note: It returns a connect_url for the operator to configure credentials

say_en.text: Look up my GitHub repos with gh
say_en.note: Goes through the proxy; the client uses gateway-managed as a placeholder

say_en.text: My GitHub request got a 403 - check which layer blocked it
say_en.note: It reports the hostname and error for a host-side check
